description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:313 — DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains matches() calls cert.tbs_certificate.issuer.to_string().to_lowercase() on every invocation. For a store with N deviations checked against each of M certs in a chain, this allocates N*M strings. The to_string() on x509_cert::name::Name is particularly expensive (formats a full DN string). Since the substring is pre-normalized to lowercase at insertion time, only the cert-side DN needs lowercasing at match time. Optimization: cache or intern the cert's issuer string, or use a non-allocating comparison. At minimum, avoid calling .to_string() + .to_lowercase() as two separate allocations — use a single fold or bytestring comparison.
title: IssuerDnContains matching allocates String per call via .to_string()
